subject_uz: "Jadidlar izidan" respublika tanlovini telekoʻrsatuv shaklida yozib olish va efirga uzatish xizmatlari (jami 52 ta teleko'rsatuv)

requirements.summary_uz: Telekoʻrsatuvlar oʻz efiridan tashqari boshqa telekanallarda ham efirga uzatilganligi isbotlanishi kerak (5 ball).
requirements.summary_en: Proof that earlier programmes were also broadcast on channels other than the bidder's own (5 points).
requirements.quote: Loyihalar doirasida tayyorlagan telekoʻrsatuvlarni oʻz efiridan boshqa telekanallarda ham efirga uzatilganligi (buni isbotlovchi materiallar)

requirements.summary_uz: Telekanal sifatida faoliyat yuritish hujjatlari: OAV sifatida davlat roʻyxatidan oʻtganlik guvohnomasi va idoralararo komissiya litsenziyasi (4 ball).
requirements.summary_en: Documents to operate as a TV channel: media registration certificate and the inter-agency commission licence (4 points).
requirements.quote: Telekanal sifatida faoliyat yuritishi uchun hujjatlar (AOKAdan OAV sifatida davlat roʻyxatidan oʻtgani haqidagi guvohnomasi va Vazirlar Mahkamasi qoshidagi Idoralararo muvofiqlashtirish komissiyasi tomonidan beriladigan litsenziya)

requirements.summary_uz: Avval respublika darajasidagi tanlovlarni televizion formatda oʻtkazish tajribasi: loyihalar roʻyxati va namunalar (5 ball).
requirements.summary_en: Prior experience of running national-level contests in TV format: list of projects and samples (5 points).
requirements.quote: Avval ham respublika darajasidagi tanlovlarni televizon formatda oʻtkazish tajribasi (amalga oshirgan loyihalari roʻyxati va telekoʻrsatuvlardan namunalar)

requirements.summary_uz: Xizmat koʻrsatishda zarur vositalar (texnika) mavjudligi haqida ma'lumot (3 ball).
requirements.summary_en: Information on the equipment needed to perform the service (3 points).
requirements.quote: Ishtirokchi tomonidan ish va xizmatlarni koʻrsatishda zarur boʻlgan vositalarning mavjudligi toʻgʻrisida maʼlumotlar

requirements.summary_uz: Har bir teleko'rsatuv ijrochining o'z efiridan tashqari kamida 2 ta markaziy telekanalda efirga uzatilishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: Each programme must be aired on at least 2 central TV channels in addition to the bidder's own.
requirements.quote: O‘zidan tashqari kamida 2 ta markaziy telekanalda efirga uzatish;

requirements.summary_uz: Respublika bosqichi yakunlari bo'yicha 45 daqiqalik teleko'rsatuv tayyorlash va efirga uzatish (10 ta); boshqa bosqichlar uchun 14 tadan.
requirements.summary_en: A 45-minute programme on the republic-stage results, 10 episodes; the other stages are 14 episodes each.
requirements.quote: respublika bosqichi yakunlari bo’yicha 45 daqiqali teleko‘rsatuv tayyorlash va efirga uzatish

requirements.summary_uz: Xizmat avans to'langandan yoki akkreditiv ochilgandan so'ng 31.12.2026 gacha bajarilishi lozim.
requirements.summary_en: The service must be completed by 31.12.2026 after the advance is paid or the letter of credit is opened.
requirements.quote: Oldindan toʻlov amalga oshirilgan yoki akkreditiv ochilgandan soʻng 31.12.2026-y. qadar amalga oshirilishi lozim

requirements.summary_uz: Texnik topshiriqda xizmat muddati shartnoma tuzilgan kundan 5 oy deb yozilgan (platformada 60 oy ko'rsatilgan).
requirements.summary_en: The technical specification states a service period of 5 months from the contract date (the platform lists 60 months).
requirements.quote: Xizmatlarni koʻrsatish muddati: shartnoma tuzilgan kundan boshlab 5 oy ichida.

requirements.summary_uz: Mahalliy ishtirokchilar uchun 30% oldindan to'lov, qolgan 70% oylik dalolatnoma qabul qilingandan so'ng 10 ish kuni ichida.
requirements.summary_en: For local bidders 30 percent in advance, the remaining 70 percent within 10 working days after the monthly acceptance act.
requirements.quote: Oylik toʻlov miqdorining oldindan 30 % toʼlov, qolgan 70 % qismi

requirements.summary_uz: Texnik baholash 30 ball; hujjatda kamida 10 ball talab qilinadi, platformada esa o'tish bali 20. Narx ulushi 100% deb ko'rsatilgan.
requirements.summary_en: Technical scoring totals 30 points; the document requires at least 10, while the platform shows a pass mark of 20. The platform lists price at 100 percent.
requirements.quote: Tanlash ishtirokchilari jami 30 ballik baholash tizimidan kamida 10 ball toʻplashlari zarur.

requirements.summary_uz: Hujjatda taklif ta'minoti 0% deb yozilgan, platformada esa 3% ko'rsatilgan; aniqlashtirish kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The document sets bid security at 0 percent while the platform shows 3 percent; this should be clarified.
requirements.quote: Tanlash taklifining taʼminoti miqdori Umumiy summaning 0 % miqdori

flags.quote: Telekanal sifatida faoliyat yuritishi uchun hujjatlar (AOKAdan OAV sifatida davlat roʻyxatidan oʻtgani haqidagi guvohnomasi va Vazirlar Mahkamasi qoshidagi Idoralararo muvofiqlashtirish komissiyasi tomonidan beriladigan litsenziya)
flags.explanation_uz: Lotda teleko'rsatuvlarni suratga olish va tayyorlash o'z efirida hamda kamida 2 ta markaziy kanalda efirga uzatish bilan birlashtirilgan, shuning uchun telekanal hujjatlari (4 ball) majburiy hisoblanadi. 30 balldan 14 balli (5+4+5) telekanal bo'lish va oldingi televizion tajribaga bog'liq; platformadagi o'tish bali 20 bo'lgani uchun bu uch mezon bo'lmasa qolgan 16 ball yetmaydi. Mustaqil ishlab chiqarish kompaniyasi kanal bilan shartnoma orqali xizmatni bajara olsa ham, taklifdan chetda qolishi mumkin. Lot narxi 950 000 000 so'm.
flags.explanation_en: The lot combines filming and producing the programmes with broadcasting on the bidder's own channel and at least 2 central channels, so TV-channel documents (4 points) become effectively mandatory. 14 of the 30 points (5+4+5) depend on being a channel with prior TV experience; with a platform pass mark of 20, the remaining 16 points cannot reach it. An independent production company that could deliver through a contract with a broadcaster may be shut out. The lot start price is 950,000,000 UZS.
flags.rewrite_uz: Ishtirokchi teleko'rsatuvlarni tayyorlaydi va ularni o'z efirida yoki shartnoma asosida jalb qilingan litsenziyali telekanallar orqali efirga uzatishni ta'minlaydi; efirga uzatish shartnomasi nusxasi taqdim etiladi.
flags.rewrite_en: The bidder produces the programmes and ensures their broadcast on its own channel or through licensed TV channels engaged by contract; a copy of the broadcasting agreement is submitted.

flags.quote: Avval ham respublika darajasidagi tanlovlarni televizon formatda oʻtkazish tajribasi (amalga oshirgan loyihalari roʻyxati va telekoʻrsatuvlardan namunalar)
flags.explanation_uz: Respublika darajasidagi tanlovlarni televizion formatda o'tkazgan tajriba 5 ball beradi, oldingi ko'rsatuvlarning boshqa kanallarda efirga uzatilganligi yana 5 ball beradi; jami 30 balldan 10 ball faqat o'tmishdagi shunday loyihalarga bog'liq. Hujjatda necha loyiha yoki qaysi davr kerakligi aytilmagan va bunday tajribaga ega kompaniyalar kam bo'lishi mumkin.
flags.explanation_en: Experience running national-level contests in TV format gives 5 points and proof that earlier shows aired on other channels gives another 5, so 10 of 30 points depend on past projects of this kind. The document does not say how many projects or which period count, and few companies may hold such experience.
flags.rewrite_uz: Ishtirokchi oxirgi 5 yil ichida kamida 1 ta televizion loyiha (ko'rsatuv yoki tanlov) tayyorlagani haqida ma'lumot va namunalar taqdim etadi; ball loyihalar soniga qarab beriladi.
flags.rewrite_en: The bidder provides information and samples showing at least 1 television project (programme or contest) produced in the last 5 years; points are awarded by the number of projects.

flags.quote: Oldindan toʻlov amalga oshirilgan yoki akkreditiv ochilgandan soʻng 31.12.2026-y. qadar amalga oshirilishi lozim
flags.explanation_uz: Takliflar 20-noyabrda yopiladi, shartnoma g'olib aniqlanganidan keyin 10 kun ichida tuziladi, xizmat esa 31.12.2026 gacha tugashi kerak: bu bir oy-bir yarim oy ichida hududlarda suratga olish va 14+14+14+10 = 52 ta teleko'rsatuvni tayyorlab efirga uzatishni bildiradi. Texnik topshiriqda esa muddat 5 oy, platformada 60 oy deb yozilgan, ya'ni muddat hujjatlarda bir-biriga mos emas.
flags.explanation_en: Bids close on 20 November, the contract is signed within 10 days of the award and the service must finish by 31.12.2026, which leaves roughly six weeks to film in the regions and produce and broadcast 14+14+14+10 = 52 programmes. The technical specification says 5 months and the platform says 60 months, so the deadline is inconsistent across the documents.
flags.rewrite_uz: Xizmat shartnoma tuzilgan kundan boshlab 5 oy ichida, tanlov bosqichlari jadvaliga muvofiq ko'rsatiladi; bosqichlar jadvali xarid hujjatlariga ilova qilinadi.
flags.rewrite_en: The service is performed within 5 months of the contract date according to the contest-stage schedule, which is attached to the procurement documents.

flags.quote: Tanlash takliflarini taqdim etish muddati 5 ish kuni
flags.explanation_uz: Takliflarni taqdim etish uchun 5 ish kuni belgilangan (platformada 14 va 20-noyabr), bu telekanal hujjatlari, tajriba namunalari va uchta kafolat xatini yig'ish uchun qisqa bo'lishi mumkin. Lot narxi 950 000 000 so'm, e'lon qayta berilgan.
flags.explanation_en: Only 5 working days are set for submitting bids (14 to 20 November on the platform), which may be short for gathering TV-channel documents, experience samples and the guarantee letters. The lot start price is 950,000,000 UZS and the announcement is a re-announcement.
flags.rewrite_uz: Tanlash takliflarini taqdim etish muddati e'lon qilingan kundan boshlab kamida 10 ish kunini tashkil qiladi.
flags.rewrite_en: The deadline for submitting bids is at least 10 working days from the date of the announcement.
